title: What Fruits Classify as a Berry

cards.answer: Myth: strawberries have seeds outside, so they are not berries; bananas are.

cards.prompt: What is the biological definition of a berry?
cards.answer: A fleshy fruit that develops from a single flower with one ovary, usually containing many seeds inside.

cards.prompt: Which of these is a true berry?
cards.answer: Banana: seeds inside a fleshy fruit from a single flower with one ovary.

cards.prompt: Which is NOT a berry biologically?
cards.answer: Strawberry has its seeds on the outside.

cards.prompt: A friend says berries are defined by being small, sweet and red. How do you correct them?
cards.answer: Botanists define berries by structure: fleshy fruit from one flower with one ovary, seeds inside. So tomatoes and bananas count, strawberries don't.
